listings.title: LABO Nutrition Bioactive Organic Fiber Sunfiber Gut & Regularity 30 sachets
bullets: 7g of Sunfiber (PHGG) – Gentle, Soluble Prebiotic Fiber for Regularity: Each serving delivers 7g of Sunfiber, a researched prebiotic fiber supplement made from partially hydrolyzed guar gum (PHGG). It may support digestive regularity and gut motility by helping food move at a healthy pace through the gut. Unlike many fiber powders that are high in FODMAPs and cause bloating or gas, this low FODMAP fiber is gentle, non-fermenting, and Monash University certified. Higher fiber content than psyllium husk.

Fast-Dissolving, Tasteless & Grit-Free Powder for Easy Daily Use: This soluble fiber powder is 100% water soluble, tasteless, and odorless—dissolving completely in water, juice, coffee, or smoothies. It mixes clearly without altering the taste, texture, or color of your favorite beverages or meals. Low in calories and easy to prepare, it's an ideal way to close the fiber gap in any diet. A great option for those seeking a clear prebiotic fiber powder that’s versatile and convenient for daily gut health.

Comfortable, Non-Bulking Fiber That Supports Nutrient Absorption: Unlike other fiber supplements that may block or bulk up the gut, Bioactive Organic Fiber slows gastric transit time to promote a comfortable feeling of fullness and satiety. It’s designed to support gut healthay and may assist in digestive nutrient support as part of a balanced diet, including calcium, iron, and zinc. Ours work with your body to maximize digestive support without discomfort.

Prebiotic Fiber for Gut Health & Microbiome Balance: Backed by science, this soluble prebiotic fiber helps maintain digestive health and balance by feeding beneficial gut bacteria. It supports digestive regularity, supports gut microbial balance, and microbiome diversity. A perfect choice for those seeking a low FODMAP prebiotic powder to support gut flora, immune support, and long-term digestive wellness.

Clean-Label Formula – Vegan, Non-GMO, FODMAP Certified: Formulated for sensitive systems, this fiber supplement is gluten-free, vegan, grit-free, and low calorie. Free from artificial ingredients, glyphosate, and allergens like soy and dairy. Certified low FODMAP by Monash University, this prebiotic fiber is ideal for individuals with sensitive guts. Comes in 30 convenient travel-ready sachets—perfect for use at home, work, or on the go.
